# Douglas M. Smith (R): NYS Assembly, District 5

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Douglas M. Smith's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.smithfornewyork.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Victoria Russell](../russell-victoria/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/smith-douglas> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A detailed incumbent biography that checks out on the record. Some figures are leftovers from 2022.

1. His 2018 special election, Education Committee ranking role and 67% in 2022 are all confirmed.
2. The "48% of New Yorkers and 60% of Long Islanders voted for a new direction" line refers to the 2022 governor's race and was never updated.
